name: breathing-hero
title: Breathing hero
description: A wellness opening with a ring that breathes in, holds and out on a 4-4-6 rhythm, the words to match, a pause control and a start button.
docs: pattern is seconds in, hold and out (4, 4 and 6 by default; a hold of 0 skips it). The ring is moved by CSS animations whose length comes from the pattern, so no script runs per frame; one timer wakes at each change of phase to update the words and the status announcement, which is polite and stops while paused. A Pause and Resume button is always there: leave paused out to let it work, or pass paused and onPausedChange to control it. onStart is called when the main button is pressed, or pass ctaHref to make it a link. Under reduced motion the ring stays still and the words and a thin progress line in three named parts (In 4s, Hold 4s, Out 6s) carry the timing. onStart is a function, so use the hero inside a Client Component. A pattern you change while it runs takes effect from the current phase; give the hero a new key to start again from the first breath. labels translates the fixed words, the three timing captions included ({count} stands for the seconds). Any other prop, such as an id for a nav anchor, aria or data attributes or a ref, goes to the section.
